name: Detect Google Keyword Trend Breakouts with Pangolinfo and n8n

parameters.content:
## Google keyword trend and breakout monitor

Track up to five product keywords in Google Trends, calculate recent momentum from the returned timeline, surface breakout related searches, and alert when demand shifts materially.

### Business outcome
- Compare up to five keywords in one request
- Calculate recent versus previous-period momentum
- Extract breakout and rising related queries
- Create an evidence-based product-demand alert

This template requires self-hosted n8n with the `n8n-nodes-pangolinfo` community node enabled.

[Product page](https://www.pangolinfo.com/ai-overview-serp-api/) · [API documentation](https://docs.pangolinfo.com/en-api-reference/trendsApi/keywordTrendsAPI)

## 1. Configure the monitor

Edit only **Monitoring Configuration**. Replace all sample identifiers, thresholds, marketplace settings, and email addresses. Select a Pangolinfo credential on the orange node.

Use **Test Workflow Manually** first. Activate the daily schedule only after the output matches your monitoring goal.

## 2. Collect and analyze

**Prepare Monitoring Jobs** validates the input and creates bounded API jobs. **Get Google Keyword Trends** retrieves current structured data. **Analyze Current Data** normalizes response variations, calculates the use-case metrics, and records human-readable alert reasons.

## 3. Aggregate and alert

**Build Monitoring Report** produces one Markdown portfolio report. Only failed thresholds reach **Email Monitoring Alert**; healthy executions still return a structured summary.

Connect SMTP or replace the final alert node with Slack, Teams, Jira, a database, or a data warehouse.
